description: 把腾讯WorkBuddy账号变成 OpenAI 兼容 API 的多账号网关，同时自动完成任务中心全部任务，附 Web 管理面板（账号池可视化 / 积分任务 / 配置热更新）。基于 Sliverkiss/workbuddy2api 的增强分支
vibe: Time-tag it once in Shanghai time, and let the workflow do the rest.
highlights: Uses a date-and-time version scheme instead of upstream semver, with a strict vYYYY.M.D.HMM format.
Documents a silent timezone failure mode: TZ=Asia/Shanghai can fall back to UTC on machines without tzdata, producing tags 8 hours early.
Enforces one version number across tag, Release, and binary, with the binary omitting the v prefix.
Ties release creation to the v* tag trigger rather than manual release steps.
Explicitly forbids v1.x tags and manual appVersion edits to prevent version drift.
assessment: This is a tight release contract rather than a broad coding manifesto. Its strength is encoding a real, silent failure mode directly beside the exact shell workaround, turning tribal knowledge into executable procedure. The single-version rule across tag, Release, and binary prevents drift and keeps the panel's display logic simple.
